island.title: Norma Island
island.native_approval: Open the original agent card to handle this confirmation.
island.staff_guide: Enable Norma Staff in Settings to chat and hear progress reports.
island.expired: This request is no longer available.
island.unconfirmed: Delivery could not be confirmed. Check the original card.
island.card_missing: The card is no longer available. Refresh the workspace and try again.
island.read_failed: Could not save the read receipt. Try again.
island.allow_always_hint: Allow these exact tool inputs on this card in this project.
island.allow_remembered: This exact operation will be allowed on this card.
island.allow_not_saved: Allowed once. Could not save the remembered permission.
island.allow_not_supported: This request does not expose a reusable exact permission.
island.no_running_hint: Activity from all workspaces appears here
island.no_pending_hint: Approvals, questions and results appear here
island.settings_hint: Choose when the island appears. Turning off popups keeps pending items available when you open it.
island.hotkey_unavailable: The system-wide shortcut %{shortcut} could not be registered (error %{code}). It may be used by another app; choose a different one.
island.remembered_cleared: Cleared %{count} remembered permissions. Matching requests will ask again.
island.notify_question: An agent has a question for you
island.staff_loading: Staff settings are still loading. Try again in a moment.
island.staff_disabled: Norma Staff is turned off. Enable it in Settings to chat.
island.staff_no_workspace: Open a workspace first; Staff needs one to work from.
island.staff_nothing_to_report: Nothing running or failing to report right now.
island.staff_empty: Ask Staff to look across all your workspaces, or press Report for a spoken summary.
island.staff_speech_unavailable: Speech is unavailable, so this reply is text only.
island.staff_no_summary: No report yet. Press Speak progress or ask below.
island.notify_permission_denied: System notifications are off for Norma, so a hidden island cannot alert you. Allow them in System Settings → Notifications.
